# Condition Parameter

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](gmeow-ConditionParameter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ConditionParameter>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A named binding that instantiates a condition template — 'threshold = 0.8', 'jurisdiction = Canada'. Lets one [`Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) serve many norms with different bindings.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](gmeow-ConditionParameter.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a named slot of a condition template so one [`Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) can serve many norms with different values — 'threshold = 0.8', 'jurisdiction = Canada'.

### Avoid when

- Avoid duplicating a whole condition per binding (parameterize it instead) and avoid carrying both a literal and an entity binding on one parameter (it carries exactly one — SHACL).

### How to use

- Mint the parameter with [`gmeow:parameterName`](../properties/gmeow-parameterName.md) and exactly one of [`gmeow:parameterValue`](../properties/gmeow-parameterValue.md) / [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](../properties/gmeow-parameterEntity.md), then attach it to the condition via [`gmeow:conditionParameter`](../properties/gmeow-conditionParameter.md).

### Examples

- ex:p1 a [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](gmeow-ConditionParameter.md); [`gmeow:parameterName`](../properties/gmeow-parameterName.md) "threshold"; [`gmeow:parameterValue`](../properties/gmeow-parameterValue.md) "0.8".
